_notes: Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy and Zomato are whole categories on the 5% list, so they map. Utilities, insurance, travel and offline are not excluded, so they earn 1%. Mapping rule (same as the agent's prompt): a merchant-specific rate is applied to a whole category only if those merchants are most of it; otherwise the base rate is kept and it's listed under _merchant_specific.
